info.title: Freya Bank voice statement and debt services (test-environment mock)
info.description: Mock of Freya Bank's seven voice-assistant services for the statement/debt use case, per the bank's service contract of 1 October 2026. Every service is POST with JSON in and out. Request body: {"data": {service fields}, "call": {"ani": caller's number, "lang": "tr"}}. Response: {"data": {...}, "result": {...}}; success = HTTP 200 and result.returnCode "1"; error answers carry only result (returnCode/code, messageText/message, type ERROR or WARNING). Dates are strings dd.MM.yyyy; amounts are JSON numbers with a dot decimal separator, never rounded. Services return raw values only, no sentences for the caller. The caller is already identified: start from cards_list with the customer number. Send cardNumber exactly as cards_list returned it. The test environment does not check the token, headers or the call object; only data fields decide the answer.

post.summary: List the caller's cards the assistant may talk about.
post.description: Returns the customer's active cards (status A) for a customer number. Two cards can share the same productName and cardNumberLast4 and differ only in the first six digits. exitState is 1_CARD for one card, MULTI_CARD for several. HTTP 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 (WARNING) means the customer has no card the assistant can work with; HTTP 500 FBE00099 is a technical error. Amounts and dates: none here.

post.summary: Get the card's statement and due dates and its debt per currency.
post.description: Returns the last issued statement date and its due date (statementDate, lastPayDate), the coming ones (nextStatementDate, nextLastPayDate), and one debt block per currency: debtTL, debtUSD, debtEUR, debtGBP. A block can be missing. Amounts are plain numbers with a dot as decimal separator, dates dd.MM.yyyy. The cardNumber in this answer is masked differently (first 4 + last 4); do not match it against the card list. HTTP 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_120 = card not found; 500 FBE00099 = technical error. The answer can occasionally take more than ten seconds.

post.summary: Get the card's current statement week and day, and whether it shares a statement with another card.
post.description: Returns statementWeek (1-4) and statementDay (day of month) as numbers, the statement and due dates, and joint-statement info: relationType is empty when the card has its own statement, M (this is the main card of the pair) or C (this card is linked to the main card) when two cards share one statement; relatedCardNumber and relatedCardProductName then name the other card. Changing the week of either card moves the shared statement of both. There is no field saying whether the week may still be changed. HTTP 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_121 = card not found; 500 FBE00099 = technical error.

post.summary: Preview the statement and due dates the card would get with a new statement week (changes nothing).
post.description: Preview only: returns the first statement date (statementDate), its due date (statementDueDate, not lastPayDate) and the statement day the card would get with the requested week. It does not change the card. Requesting the card's current week, an unknown card or a week outside 1-4 gives HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR. responseCode 0 = fine. HTTP 500 FBE00099 = technical error.

Must differ from the card's current statementWeek; statementDay (integer, required): The card's current statementDay from statement_week_get (required by the request model; the bank recalculates the day itself).

post.summary: Get the customer's registered e-mail address and phone.
post.description: Returns the registered e-mail in ibanEmail (ttsEmail is the same address prepared for reading aloud) and the phone in ibanCountryCode / ibanAreaCode / ibanPhoneNum. No registered e-mail = communicationType Phone and/or an empty ibanEmail: check the field, not only the type. The iban prefix is historical and has nothing to do with IBANs. Unknown customer or empty intAddressInfoType gives HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR; HTTP 500 FBE00099 = technical error.

data.description: Service fields: customerNo (string, required): Customer number the phone menu hands over with the call, e.g. "90000001". Sent as a string or a number, both accepted; intAddressInfoType (string, required): What to fetch: E e-mail, P phone, B both. Required (empty gives 400); the test environment answers the same for all three. Send E to get the e-mail.

post.summary: Send the issued statement as a PDF to an e-mail address.
post.description: Sends the statement PDF of the card for the given currency and statement date to emailAddress. The bank sends to whatever address is in the field and does not compare it with the registered one. Success = data.exitState DONE. HTTP 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_107 (WARNING) = no statement document to send; HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR = a field is missing or empty; HTTP 500 FBE00099 = technical error. Has a side effect: do not retry automatically.

Never rebuilt from digits the caller says; currencyType (string, required): Currency of the statement: TL, USD, EUR or GBP; statementDate (string, required): The statementDate from cards_balance (the issued statement). Date as dd.MM.yyyy, e.g. 05.11.2026; emailAddress (string, required): E-mail address to send the PDF to.
